title: Tangent identities at a normalized bias
statement: Let $p,\alpha,\beta\in\bbr$ satisfy $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, and $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$. Set $t=(\beta-\alpha)/(\beta+\alpha)$ and $S=(1+t)^p+(1-t)^p$. Then $S^{2/p}=4/(\alpha+\beta)^2$ and $S^{2/p-1}\big((1+t)^{p-1}-(1-t)^{p-1}\big)/t=2(\beta^{p-1}-\alpha^{p-1})/(\beta-\alpha)$.
replaced: Let $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, and $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$. Put $t=(\beta-\alpha)/(\beta+\alpha)$ and $S=(1+t)^p+(1-t)^p$. Then $S^{2/p}=4/(\alpha+\beta)^2$ and $S^{2/p-1}((1+t)^{p-1}-(1-t)^{p-1})/t=2(\beta^{p-1}-\alpha^{p-1})/(\beta-\alpha)$.
